description: The file defines the class 'HttplugFactory' which implements factory interfaces for creating HTTP message components such as Request, Response, Stream, and Uri. It is a deprecated factory class that was part of the Nyholm PSR-7 implementation, providing methods to generate HTTP message objects.

classes.name: HttplugFactory
classes.description: A deprecated factory class implementing MessageFactory, StreamFactory, and UriFactory to create HTTP message components such as requests, responses, streams, and URIs.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Request object with specified method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object with specified status code, reason phrase, headers, body, and version.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Stream object from the given body.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Uri object or returns the input if it is already a UriInterface.
